# Empty DrawingML paths

Original OPC/XML controls generated by `tools/empty_drawing_paths_fixture.py`,
using the existing original Bézier fixture scaffold. No corpus artwork is used.
ECMA-376 Part 1 §20.1.9.15 and Annex A.4.1 CT_Path2D allow zero commands.

The first three controls contain only an empty filled/stroked, fill-only or
stroke-only path. The other three combine an empty path with a visible rectangle:
empty before visible, empty after visible, and nested groups. The reference application draws no ink
for the first three and retains the rectangles in the latter three.

`native.pdf` was exported with the reference application using
`tools/export-reference.ps1`. `tools/bezier_reference.py
empty-drawing-paths` extracts 48 color cross-sections, including empty regions;
the browser regression compares interval counts and edges within 0.75 pt before
and after editing, undo and export/reopen. Horizontal sample rows avoid rectangle
stroke edges where PDF/canvas antialiasing can change the threshold classification.
The source SHA-256 is recorded in `reference.json`.

The page pair was visually inspected. The scaffold's unspecified paragraph font
differs between the reference application and the app; these page-anchored controls isolate drawing
geometry and do not certify default-font matching. Corpus originals remain outside
the repository. Nonempty paths without an initial move remain rejected.
